clips.title: The story
paras: The Call of Water is an elemental rite of passage where shamans learn to commune with water spirits and wield their restorative powers. By retrieving a Shard of Water from Westfall for Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan, initiates prove their dedication and receive their water totem.

The Call of Water is a vital spiritual trial undertaken by shamans to forge a bond with the element of water. Initiates are tasked with journeying to Westfall and returning to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan with the Shard of Water. By demonstrating their understanding of water's life-giving essence and its role in purging corruption, shamans earn their water totem and take an essential step on their elemental journey.

The trial imparts a foundational elemental truth: water is life, and corruption brings an end to life. Shamans are charged with wielding water's restorative strength to protect the vulnerable and preserve living things. As mentor Norric Lochthane observes upon receiving the Shard of Water, the pure gifts of water reach far beyond simple physical mending, touching upon endurance, renewal, and spiritual balance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take shard. Take shard and give life.
Give life and understand. Understand water is life... Corruption stops life.
You protect and give life with water's power.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How fared your journey to Westfall? Success there is hard to measure, but even small victories carry weight.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aye, this is the proof I asked for, and ye've done well, friend. I'm proud to be the first to offer my congratulations--and yer water totem. Use it wisely, and may fortune walk beside ye.
Yer next trial won't come soon, so take this time to learn. Pure water heals, aye, but its gifts go far beyond mending wounds.
